_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.
_bot_token_help: Get one from @BotFather on Telegram: /newbot, then copy the token it gives you.
_chat_id_help: Send any message to your bot, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates in your browser. Look for 'chat':{id:...}
_start_token_help: Token to scan routes from. Options: WPLS, HEX, eHEX, INC, WETH, PLSX, pDAI, DAI, USDC
_amount_in_help: Simulated trade size in human units (e.g. 1000 = 1000 WPLS). The flash swap borrows this amount; you do not need to hold it.
_min_profit_bps_help: Minimum gross profit in basis points of amount_in before alerting. 0 = alert on any net-positive route. 50 = only alert if profit >= 0.5% of trade size.
_min_net_usd_help: Minimum net profit in USD (after estimated gas) before sending a Telegram alert. Default 0.50 filters out hairline-positive ticks. The CSV scan log still records every best route regardless of this floor.
_scan_interval_help: Seconds between scans. 30 is a reasonable default; below 10 may hit RPC rate limits.
_dedup_help: Suppress repeat Telegram alerts for the same route for this many minutes.
_v3_depth_help: V3 tick intervals to read per pool (1-8). Higher = more accurate for large trades but more RPC calls. 4 matches the browser default.
_triangular_help: Also scan triangular 3-hop routes (S -> Y -> Z -> S). Doubles scan time slightly.
_csv_log_help: Append one row per scan to a CSV recording the single best (most-promising) route that scan, even when it loses money after gas. Great for studying near-misses over time. Set false to disable.
_csv_path_help: CSV file to write. Relative paths are resolved inside the server/ folder; absolute paths are used as-is. The file is gitignored by default.
_rpc_help: PulseChain RPC endpoint(s). The first one is used. Add a backup as a second element if you have one.
